title: A Train Tunnel Runs 35 Miles With 1.4 Miles of Mountain Above

scenes.text: This train tunnel runs 35 miles under the Alps.
It's the Gotthard Base Tunnel in Switzerland.
At its deepest, about 2,300 meters of rock sit on top. That's nearly a mile and a half.
Passenger trains hit 125 miles an hour inside. Cargo trains reach 62.
It took 17 years to build and cost about 12 billion Swiss francs.
A mile and a half of mountain over your head, at 125 miles an hour.

description:
The Gotthard Base Tunnel in Switzerland runs about 35 miles under the Alps, with up to 2,300 meters of rock above it.
Passenger trains reach 125 miles an hour inside, and it took 17 years to build.
Would you ride a train through it?
first_comment: What is the longest tunnel you have driven through?
